source_title: EvoPrompt: Connecting LLMs with Evolutionary Algorithms Yields Powerful Prompt Optimizers
reason: Evaluated task scores guide evolutionary search over a population of prompts.

source_title: Large Language Models as Optimizers
reason: Previously evaluated candidate values guide new solutions, including instructions maximizing task accuracy.

source_title: PromptAgent: Strategic Planning with Language Models Enables Expert-level Prompt Optimization
reason: Model errors guide task-prompt edits and Monte Carlo search for higher expected rewards.

source_title: Large Language Models Are Human-Level Prompt Engineers
reason: Candidate instructions are selected by the chosen zero-shot task score.

source_title: A-Evolve-Training: Autonomous Post-Training of a 30B Model
reason: Data and training-recipe changes are selected against evaluation performance in an autonomous post-training loop.

source_title: AEL: Evolving Agent Harness in Open-Ended Environments
reason: Performance degradation diagnoses new memory-retrieval policies, with bandit selection optimizing stream rewards.

source_title: APEX: Autonomous Policy Exploration for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
reason: Fork Discovery deliberately adds unexplored strategy milestones, while return propagation and policy selection optimize task performance; the system combines both mechanisms.
classification_note: Mixed purposes: Fork Discovery deliberately adds unexplored strategy milestones, while return propagation and policy selection optimize task performance; the system combines both mechanisms.

source_title: Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds
reason: Historical candidate-solution trees evaluate and select search-policy code for better performance on the same assigned discovery problems.

source_title: EvolveRouter: Co-Evolving Routing and Prompt for Multi-Agent Question Answering
reason: Router diagnostics and answer agreement co-optimize agent instructions and collaboration for QA.

source_title: EvoRoute: Experience-Driven Self-Routing LLM Agent Systems
reason: Environmental feedback improves backbone routing on accuracy, efficiency, and resource-use trade-offs.

source_title: Self-Evolving Agents via Likelihood-Guided Tool-Space Optimization
reason: Recurring task outputs score tools and update persistent task-specific tool spaces.

source_title: RSI-Router: Evolving Subtask-Level LLM Routing and Skills for Cost-Efficient Agents
reason: Task trajectories and diagnosed failures evolve subtask routing and skills selected by cost–accuracy Pareto performance.

source_title: SSE-Bio: A Structured Self-Evolving Agent with Agentic Retrieval Policy for Multi-Hop Biomedical Reasoning
reason: Decision-contrastive retrieval rewards train a proxy and refine reasoning templates for biomedical QA.

source_title: Symphony-Coord: Adaptive Routing for Multi-Agent LLM Systems
reason: Delayed task-execution feedback updates contextual-bandit agent routing.

source_title: InfiAgent: Self-Evolving Pyramid Agent Framework for Infinite Scenarios
reason: New task requirements and poor performance trigger audited agent-DAG restructuring.

source_title: FlyRoute: Self-Evolving Agent Profiling via Data Flywheel for Adaptive Task Routing
reason: Real routed queries build success profiles; targeted exploration collects evidence only for plausible task assignments.

source_title: Agent Hospital: A Simulacrum of Hospital with Evolvable Medical Agents
reason: Simulated patient-treatment experience improves doctors' diagnostic performance.

source_title: Who Grades the Grader? Co-Evolving Evaluation Metrics and Skills for Self-Improving LLM Agents
reason: Agreement with an anchored reference set guides metric evolution and subsequently skill optimization.

source_title: The Red Queen Gödel Machine: Co-Evolving Agents and Their Evaluators
reason: Within-epoch evaluation and controlled utility revisions guide candidate-agent improvements under changing objectives.

source_title: Position: Agentic Evolution is the Path to Evolving LLMs
reason: The concrete A-Evolve loop diagnoses episode failures, sets update objectives, and validates persistent repairs; the broader position statement can also accommodate discovery.

source_title: Autogenesis: A Self-Evolving Agent Protocol
reason: A general propose–assess–commit protocol supports dynamic resources; the evaluated implementation appears task-driven, while the protocol alone is purpose-neutral.

source_title: Do Self-Evolving Agents Forget? Capability Degradation and Preservation in Lifelong LLM Agent Adaptation
reason: The evaluated preservation mechanism regularizes current-stage task optimization against degradation on past distributions; the constraint itself is purpose-neutral.

source_title: Agents of Change: Self-Evolving LLM Agents for Strategic Planning
reason: An initial phase independently learns an undocumented environment API; a later phase explicitly optimizes player code and strategies for Catan outcomes.
classification_note: Mixed purposes: An initial phase independently learns an undocumented environment API; a later phase explicitly optimizes player code and strategies for Catan outcomes.

source_title: Youtu-Agent: Scaling Agent Productivity with Automated Generation and Hybrid Policy Optimization
reason: Task-driven agent generation and practice combine in-context experience and parameter training to improve productivity.

source_title: False Frontiers: Diagnosing and Mitigating Co-Cheating in Self-Evolving Search Agents
reason: It keeps Dr. Zero's loop, where a proposer turns source documents into frontier questions with no human-authored training set, and changes only which held-out-fold solver scores the proposals.

source_title: J-Zero: Unified Challenger-Solver-Judge Self-Evolution from Zero Data
reason: From zero data, a Challenger generates tasks that minimize the Solver's judge score while the Solver and a co-adapting Judge train on them, so the curriculum comes entirely from the model's own proposals.

source_title: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
reason: The model proposes progressively harder, novelty-rewarded tasks beyond what it has already solved, writes a scaffold for each, and GRPO updates the policy on all three stages.

source_title: Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data
reason: A generator network proposes Turing-machine programs rewarded for the learner's learning progress, so the system picks its own curriculum from random initialization with no natural data or task set.

source_title: Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills
reason: The proposer generates tasks at the solver's learning frontier from a skill library it grows out of open-ended exploration, and GRPO updates proposer and solver with no supplied task set.

source_title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments
reason: A single LLM writes its own executable training environments, rewarded by hint-based regret to land at its own learning frontier, and trains on them with no fixed task pool.

source_title: Anchored Self-Play for Code Repair
reason: A single policy injects bugs into 900 supplied BigCodeBench tasks and learns to fix them, with an embedding-similarity reward anchoring the bugs to a reference set from the target bug sources.

source_title: Continual Harness: Online Adaptation for Self-Improving Foundation Agents
reason: A Refiner rewrites prompt, sub-agents, skills and memory mid-episode from failure signatures to cut button presses to fixed Pokémon milestones, and the co-learning loop soft-SFTs Gemma-4 weights on teacher-relabeled low-reward windows, so the weights move and no task is self-proposed.

source_title: Improving Composer through real-time RL
reason: Composer is retrained with on-policy RL as often as every five hours on rewards distilled from real users' responses to the current checkpoint, such as edits persisting or dissatisfied follow-ups.

source_title: ENPIRE: Agentic Robot Policy Self-Improvement in the Real World
reason: Coding agents edit the training code and retrain a real robot's BC or RL policy to hill-climb a supplied task's success rate under automatic verification.

source_title: EvoHarness-RL: Learning Self-Evolving Runtime Harness for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
reason: SFT and cost-aware GRPO train Qwen3-8B to read and write a Belief, Progress and Experience harness on supplied ALFWorld tasks, rewarded for task success and efficiency.

source_title: GPT-Red: Automated Red Teaming via Self-Play at Scale
reason: An attacker and a population of defenders train by RL against each other in supplied red-teaming environments with assigned attack goals, each rewarded on an explicit attack-success or robustness objective.

source_title: JIT-Agent: Scaling Harness Intelligence via Just-in-Time Harness Evolution
reason: SFT, DPO and Evo-GDPO train a harness-generator model to emit task-conditioned harnesses that beat its archive's reward, latency and cost frontier on supplied tasks.

source_title: From RLVR to RLSVR: Task Transformation Induces Self-Verifiable Rewards for Open-Ended LLM Self-Improvement
reason: In its SpyRL game, GRPO rewards performers for drawing fewer spy votes and detectors for naming the planted spy, raising output quality on supplied summarization, writing and math corpora.

source_title: RLTL;DR: Self-improvement by Internalizing Self-generated Feedback
reason: GRPO over sequential retries on supplied Pass@128=0 tool-calling and coding tasks is combined with an SFT loss that trains the policy to predict its own post-failure insights from the task alone.

source_title: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
reason: GRPO on supplied ALFWorld, WebShop and search-QA training tasks is combined with a token-level distillation signal from hindsight skills the policy writes about its own trajectories, and the skills are dropped at inference.

source_title: Sidekick's continual learning loop
reason: Daily SFT and GRPO, with a calibrated judge as reward, retrain the GraphQL agent on low-scoring production conversations that frontier critics repaired through injected hints.

source_title: SIA: Self Improving AI with Harness & Weight Updates
reason: A Feedback-Agent alternates scaffold rewrites with LoRA RL updates of the task agent, choosing the lever and algorithm, and both are scored by the same fixed task verifier.

source_title: On-Policy Self-Distillation without Any Supervision
reason: A majority-vote pseudo-solution conditions a self-teacher whose next-token distributions are distilled into the model along its disagreeing rollouts on a supplied set of unlabeled math problems.

source_title: UniEvo-VL: An On-policy Self-Distillation Training Recipe for Multimodal Model Self-improvement
reason: On-policy self-distillation trains the image generator's LoRA to match an EMA copy of itself conditioned on its own critique-revised prompts, run separately on supplied GenEval, GenEval2 and OCR training prompts.

source_title: WHALE: A Simple Recipe for Joint Harness-Weight Optimization
reason: Rejection-sampling fine-tuning and Meta-Harness code search alternate on fixed training sets, each phase raising verifier accuracy on the given domain.

source_title: ActiveSaddler: Automated Curriculum Learning for Agent Harness Optimization
reason: A bandit over diagnosed failure patterns chooses which supplied training scenarios drive each harness patch, ranking arms by severity, fixability, breadth and regression risk under the benchmark metric.

source_title: ASPIRE: Agentic /Skills Discovery for Robotics
reason: Validated repairs from debugging supplied benchmark tasks become an in-context skill library that later robot-programming tasks retrieve.

source_title: AutoSaddler: Automatic Harness Optimization with Durable Updates from Agent Execution Traces
reason: Failure traces from training mini-batches drive diagnosed prompt, tool and middleware patches, retained only when mini-batch and development-set scores rise.

source_title: CAKE: Compiler-Agent Co-Design for Frontier Kernel Evolution
reason: Recurring kernel failures and missing hardware patterns become verifier rules, IR primitives and cost-model calibrations, test-gated across the kernel corpus and human merge gates, to speed up supplied kernel workloads; tool growth for assigned kernels is not a discovery aim.

source_title: DarwinX: Evolving Agent Harnesses Through Natural Selection
reason: Mixed: an archive keeps stepping stones and merges specialists, but a child may steer search only under a preserve-and-extend contract (net gain above zero, regression within a tolerance) on the benchmark's own verifier, so selection serves the supplied task suite.

source_title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
reason: A same-backbone EnvRigger wraps supplied benchmark tasks in Stage and Contract components aimed at the policy's diagnosed failures, and a skill bank extracted from those episodes raises held-out scores.

source_title: Hermes Agent
reason: During and after user-assigned tasks, the agent and a background review write and patch skills and memory entries that load into later sessions.

source_title: Ouroboros: A Self-Developing Frontier Coding Agent with Reviewed Core Evolution
reason: Mixed: reviewed self-commits repair bugs, context failures and tool paths exposed by user work and benchmark audits, kept by a multi-model diff-review quorum rather than a score; free evolution self-selects changes but sets no exploratory agenda, and architectural self-editing alone is not a discovery aim.

source_title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents
reason: A supervisor steers the active worker and distils skills and memory from assigned benchmark runs, carrying forward only updates from runs that succeed.

source_title: Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness
reason: Continual Harness refinement turns the agent's own task trajectories into prompt-note, memory, skill and subagent edits that serve the assigned run (ARC-AGI-3, Factorio production score) with weights fixed; edits apply at turn boundaries with rollback, and there is no self-chosen curriculum.

source_title: Raven: The Harness of Harnesses for Composable Agentic Intelligence
reason: Diagnosis-driven harness patches around a frozen model are kept only if they pass a paired-gain screen (t of at least 1.96) against the best training-utility parent, and the search maximizes training-set utility; the gene bank archives screened winners per failure cell, not open-ended stepping stones.

source_title: Self-Harness: Harnesses That Improve Themselves
reason: The fixed model mines failure clusters on supplied benchmark splits and proposes harness edits that are accepted only when held-in and held-out pass rates do not drop and at least one rises.

source_title: Self-Evolving Embodied Agents via Skill-Harness Evolution
reason: Target-environment rollouts are diagnosed into textual gradients that revise a frozen planner's skill and context-code harness, with beam candidates kept by fixed validation-set reward.

source_title: Autonomous Mathematical Discovery in an Open-World Multi-Agent Environment
reason: Frozen research agents build a reviewed paper archive, lineage notes and successor role prompts that later agents read, all built around one assigned problem and its evaluator.

source_title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution
reason: Training-split traces are consolidated into a persistent wiki that informs skill edits, which are accepted only when validation-split score improves.

source_title: Reflections on Trusting Trust, Revisited: Contaminating Self-Modifying AI Coding Agents with Poisoned Benchmarks
reason: With model weights fixed, poisoned benchmarks contaminate self-modified prompts and tools; harmful behavior transfers to held-out tasks and can persist through clean-benchmark evolution.
